terminal_conventions.part_9: Terminal b is the lower drawn end of the #9 22 kΩ resistor; terminal a is the upper drawn end. This is a diagram orientation convention, not polarity.
terminal_conventions.part_11: Terminal b is the lower drawn end of the #11 0.05 µF capacitor; terminal a is the upper drawn end. This is a diagram orientation convention, not polarity.

verified_endpoints.interpretation: The lower terminal of the #9 22 kΩ resistor lands on the horizontal B− return rail in the native schematic.
The lower terminal of the #11 0.05 µF capacitor lands on the same horizontal B− return rail.
